final: SELECT s3.rfistat, s3.A as C, s3.A_minus_B, s3.A - s4.D as C_minus_D FROM (SELECT s1.rfistat, s1.avg_modindex as A, s2.overall_avg as B, s1.avg_modindex - s2.overall_avg as A_minus_B FROM (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) as avg_modindex FROM signals GROUP BY rfistat) s1 CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) as overall_avg FROM (SELECT AVG(modindex) as avg_modindex FROM signals GROUP BY rfistat)) s2 WHERE s2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND s1.avg_modindex > s2.overall_avg) s3 CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(A) as D FROM (SELECT s1.avg_modindex as A FROM (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) as avg_modindex FROM signals GROUP BY rfistat) s1 CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) as overall_avg FROM (SELECT AVG(modindex) as avg_modindex FROM signals GROUP BY rfistat)) s2 WHERE s2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND s1.avg_modindex > s2.overall_avg)) s4 WHERE s4.D IS NOT NULL
